purpose: Opens the signed-in person's account menu: their Avatar, an optional name and a caret on ghost button roles. Use it in a header or a sidebar footer as the trigger of a DropdownMenu.

notFor.case: Opening a menu of commands that is not about the account.
Showing who someone is, with no menu.

Focused.visual: Border/focus inside plus a Border/ring/default ring.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it. As a DropdownMenu trigger, Space / Enter / ArrowDown open the menu and Escape closes it and returns focus here (Radix DropdownMenu).
notes: aria-haspopup="menu"; named "Account menu for <name>" when the name is hidden.
Fill and ink change with the motion role use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Open: does the trigger look different while its menu is open, or does it keep Default?
The contract says "Add aria-expanded": does the component set it, or must the app? (Radix sets it when used as DropdownMenuTrigger asChild.)
There is no Disabled state in the Figma set. Is one needed (for example while the session loads)?
Reduced motion: should the use-hover colour change stay as a short fade or become instant?
